newsitem.title: UK: British monarch plans golden wedding garden party.
newsitem.headline: British monarch plans golden wedding garden party.

text.p: Britain's Queen Elizabeth plans to share her golden wedding anniversary with 4,000 other couples who married in 1947 by inviting them to a special garden party at Buckingham Palace.

Royal household officials said on Tuesday that guests for for the July 15 garden party would be selected by ballot from around Britain to choose surviving couples from around 100,000 marriages that took place in 1947.

Queen Elizabeth married Prince Philip on November 20, 1947, and the garden party is one of a series of events being organised in the summer to mark the anniversary. Another is a musical pageant about horses.
The queen's marriage contrasts strongly with the marital misfortunes of her children. Three of the four have divorced in the past five years and the youngest, Prince Edward, has yet to name a bride.
